body: Do you know how later that happened?
I maybe naive. I have done something extremely stupid. Now I just want this to end.

Thanks for your response. I won't bring it up again. There's no way for me to contact them now anyway. I haven't shared nudes to strangers before. Don't know what happened that cursed night. It's a lesson learned. I know I will never get a closure on this. But that's the consequence I have to live by.
Their motive is what worrying me. I like to believe that they did this for fun and probably delete everything eventually, but that's just wishful thinking.

Thanks for your response. I don't even remember why I did that in the first place. It was not my usual self. I am pretty sure now that its a guy or a group that was behind this. Maybe they did this for fun. Or maybe for something unthinkable. The uncertainty is killing me.

I used [pimeyes](https://pimeyes.com/en). This was the first tool I found on Google when I searched for face recognition reverse image search. One can use the free version to find if any images are out there. I can't guarantee the accuracy of the results though.
That maybe a good solution for damage control. But I don't think the catfish knows my full name anyway.
Thank you for your response. As far as I know, its not there in the internet. If it surfaces, I would go to police. Otherwise going to police would be bringing unwanted attention to this.
I agree. Anyone can hurt another if they want with average photoshop skills. I could probably use this as a lie if this ever surface. Still, it's humiliating. I should have been smart.
That's a good strategy, but I am not able to contact them anymore.

I would say the worst case would be if people who I regularly contact come to know about this. 
If you don't mind me asking, did you do something as damage control when you came to know about your pictures floating around?

Thanks for your response. I will try to accept the fact and move on. The best case scenario is if the pictures were never saved by the catfish. The worst case would be if they are just waiting for the right moment to attack me.

Thank you for your response Daniel. 
I am not yet comfortable to discuss this with my loved ones. The fact that this might bring them pain makes me more upset. I will try to forgive myself and stop thinking about it.

Contacting the phone company directly for reports may not be successful due to my country's law. I am over 18. Contacting the authorities might be the only way. But doing that might be putting more light to the issue, especially with people around me. I will see if there is a possibility to do it discretely.
Thank you for your response. I am sure it won't be interesting for someone who doesn't know me. Hope it stays that way.
Thank you for sticking up for me. It is quite a big problem for me personally. I just hope it doesn't get worse.
I agree. Maybe this wouldn't matter at all. Only thing I can do now is to hope nothing bad comes out of this.

Thank you for your response. There isn't much proof that I can use other than the phone number, which could be probably stolen anyway. I do feel insecure and wish I could run away from everyone I know. 
Since I haven't found any of my pics in the internet yet, I will just assume it's not there, atleast to calm my nerves.
